quest.title: The Forsaken Sea of Wisdom
quest.description: Find and stabilize the Astral Assemblage(s) to activate the Celestial Axis at the center of the Sacred City...

talks.objective: Try to activate the Astral Assemblage(s)
Try to activate the Astral Assemblage(s)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As you immerse yourself in the liquid Phlogiston, images flash through your mind like warm memories.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Beside the flaming pool, the silver-white and ash-covered shadows converse as such...

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "...Phase Two experimental verification is complete. I name the thing that shall purify all and evolve all 'Huitzilopochtli,' or the 'Sweeping Skyfire'..."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "Not that this matters. Names shall lose meaning in this place very soon, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: "The Astral Assemblages must be activated and actively attached to serve as countermeasures against corruption. Before they are completely warped by the Abyss, they will self-destruct and eliminate its influence..."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: But how will you accurately identify targets as having been corrupted? A controllable specimen...

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: Self-experimentation? Has sanity deserted you?

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "Hah. This too, is well. If nothing else, this decrepit body may still serve in this manner."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: So, you shall be the least likely to survive once this system is activated, then?

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: Has the Abyss at last rotted your mind? Or... do you simply wish for all your kin to be martyred upon your funeral pyre?

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "Such little faith you have in your people! All the lords have consented to this, save you."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: They merely follow your plan as though blind, never once considering the true meaning behind the scheme... This action does not have my consent.

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "...That matters little. Destruction... shall also be rebirth. I have made my mind up as such."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "Hah... I fear this is as much time as I can spend awake each day. In any case, I shall activate it once all is prepared."

dialogues.speaker: Cold Voice
dialogues.text: Is there no room for a different course? I am still searching for another way... Are you certain that you are not bathing the world in flame over some personal grudge?

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "Perhaps! I will do anything it takes to keep our shadow-foe beyond the circles of this world."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "Hah. Besides, 'another way,' you say... Will you really find what you seek from those 'humans' of yours? You are in too deep already. I see it..."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "I once tried to make you understand... But just as it was with those of our line who sought wisdom through the pools of flame, knowledge and acceptance are two different things."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "If you believe that I simply wish for 'destruction,' whereas you have a world you wish to construct... Then stop me. Slay me. Prove yourself to me!"

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "But know this, Kukulkan, though it be not prophecy — simply advice from one who once walked this path. A day shall come..."

dialogues.speaker: Somber Yet Weary Voice
dialogues.text: "...When you shall tread the same road as I."

Take a dip in the pond
